new_jobs.title: Logistics Manager (F/M/X)
new_jobs.jd: Solvay is all about chemistry. We’re not just referring to chemical reactions here, but also to the magic that occurs when the brightest minds get to work together. As a Logistics Manager (Taiwan), you will be fully based in Taiwan and lead end\-to\-end logistics operations, stakeholder collaboration and process optimization to support the stable growth of the Taiwan peroxides business. You will get the opportunity to build a robust local logistics framework, deepen cross\-regional supply chain synergy and have a positive impact on customer satisfaction, operational efficiency and business profitability in the Taiwan market. Competencies: * Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in both ongoing operations and new project phases * Fluent in written and spoken Chinese and English; additional language proficiency is a distinct advantage Behaviors: * Hands\-on, pragmatic and highly organized with strong execution capabilities * Customer\-centric mindset, prioritizing customer satisfaction and demand fulfillment * Open\-minded and solution\-oriented, especially when cooperating with suppliers or resolving operational issues **About The Pay** Attractive and equitable pay for all: compensation is determined within a range to foster your development in the role. Ensure high availability and fault tolerance by implementing redundancy, load balancing, and failover mechanisms. * Integration and Deployment: Collaborate with software engineers and DevOps teams to integrate AI models and algorithms into production environments. Develop deployment strategies and workflows for efficient deployment and management of AI HPC systems. * Research and Innovation: Stay up to date with the latest advancements in AI, machine learning, and HPC technologies. Identify and evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and tools to enhance the performance and capabilities of AI HPC systems. * Documentation and Communication: Document system designs, configurations, and performance optimizations. Communicate complex technical concepts and recommendations effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Job Qualifications** * Strong Background in AI and Machine Learning: A deep understanding of artificial intelligence and machine learning concepts, algorithms, and frameworks is essential. Knowledge of scripting languages like Bash or PowerShell is beneficial for automation and system management tasks. * HPC Tools and Frameworks: Familiarity with HPC tools and frameworks, such as MPI (Message Passing Interface), OpenMP, CUDA, or OpenCL, is valuable. Understanding how to leverage these tools for parallel computing and GPU acceleration is advantageous. * Performance Optimization: Experience in performance tuning and optimization techniques for large\-scale computing systems is essential. Knowledge of profiling tools, benchmarking, and workload management is valuable for identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks. * System Administration: Understanding system administration principles and practices is beneficial. Knowledge of Linux or UNIX\-based operating systems, system monitoring tools, and cluster management frameworks is advantageous. * Communication and Collaboration: Strong communication skills are crucial for collaborating with cross\-functional teams, including data scientists, researchers, software engineers, and IT professionals. new_jobs.title: AI Engineer, Playable Ads

Founded in 2012 with the vision of “Making AI Easy by Making Software Intelligent,” Appier helps businesses turn AI into ROI through its Ad Cloud, Personalization Cloud, and Data Cloud—each powered by Agentic AI that enables autonomous, adaptive, and real\-time decision\-making. Today, Appier operates 17 offices across APAC, the US, and EMEA, and is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Learn more at www.appier.com. **About The Role** AI is reshaping how brands connect with consumers — and at Appier, we’re at the forefront. Our Playable Ads team builds AI\-powered ad experiences — from interactive playable formats to video ads — that drive higher engagement and conversion for apps and games worldwide. We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to turn promising models and prototypes into reliable, scalable creative\-generation systems used in real products. This role sits at the intersection of applied ML and software engineering. You’ll work with scientists, backend and frontend engineers, product managers, and designers to build pipelines that generate, evaluate, and continuously improve ad creatives—while meeting production standards for quality, latency, cost, observability, and reliability. **What You’ll Work On** * Build and operate reliable, scalable ML and generative AI pipelines that power automated content creation, personalization, and optimization across a range of creative formats and products. * Productionize research prototypes and models by designing service and API contracts, containerized workers, asynchronous orchestration, artifact storage, and clear ownership boundaries. * Apply modern ML—including LLMs, VLMs, multimodal generation, and agentic tool use—to improve creative quality, automation, and personalization. * Engineer reliable workflows with schema validation, idempotency, retries, failure recovery, security, versioning, and end\-to\-end tests across staging and production. * Define and monitor quality, latency, failure\-rate, and generation\-cost metrics; comfortable using AI\-assisted development tools responsibly while validating their output. \[Preferred qualifications] * Experience with generative media, creative optimization, advertising or MarTech, recommendation, or content\-generation products. * Experience designing agent tools, feedHands\-on experience with generative AI or multimodal systems, such as LLMs, VLMs, image or video generation, RAG, tool use, or agent frameworks. * back\-loop pipelines, rigorous evaluations, or online experiments—and translating research into measurable product impact.

new_jobs.title: Product Manager
new_jobs.jd: **Company Overview:** At OnRampLab, we build products that help businesses connect with the right people, conversations, and talent. Today we operate three core products, ContactLoop (multi\-channel marketing), VoiceFusion (Voice AI engine), and RemoteHunter (remote talent platform) with several new product lines on the way. As we scale, we're adding a Product Manager to own product discovery, translate customer needs into clear direction, and drive cross\-functional coordination across our growing portfolio. Partnered with our Staff Engineer who leads technical execution, you'll have the room to focus on what matters most: making sure every product decision is driven by real customer value. **Job Description:** We're looking for a Product Manager to partner closely with our Staff Engineer / TPM and lead product direction, customer\-needs translation, and zero\-to\-one new product launches. You'll own what to build and why, while your engineering counterparts own technical execution. The ideal candidate is fluent in English, sharp under pressure, and instinctively skeptical of AI demos that look "95% there." You're a daily user of AI tools, comfortable in a US\-style work environment, and able to operate across time zones, products, and stakeholders without losing the thread. **Key Responsibilities:** * Identify what customers actually need, from interviews, support logs, usage data, and stakeholder feedback. Not just collecting requests, but judging what's worth doing. * Define what "good" means for AI products, quality bar, escalation triggers, human\-in\-the\-loop boundaries. Logic over detail. * Own one new product line from zero to one, discovery, MVP, launch, and iteration. * Act as the cross\-functional hub between Taiwan engineering, overseas colleagues, and customers, keeping things moving across multiple time zones, products, and stakeholders. * Communicate product decisions clearly, to leadership, engineering, and overseas counterparts in their own language and style. * Stay current with AI capabilities, judging what's feasible now vs. worth waiting for the next model. * Absorb light program\-management work as needed, given the multi\-time\-zone, multi\-product nature of the role. **Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree (any field). * 2\+ years of relevant experience, B2B product, UX research, customer\-facing Product Owner, or consulting backgrounds all welcome. * Fluent English (written \+ spoken), can run daily syncs with non\-Chinese\-speaking colleagues and write clear, structured, conclusion\-first documents (no buried lead, no anti\-climax). * Cross\-cultural collaboration experience across multiple time zones, comfortable in a US\-style work environment. * Quick under pressure, calm in chaos, can decide next steps with incomplete information. * Flexible communicator, adapts style for different audiences (leadership, engineering, overseas colleagues, customers) and gets people and things moving. * Sensitive to AI product quality, sees an AI demo and instinctively asks "what about the remaining 5%?" rather than being impressed by the 95%. * Daily user of AI tools (Claude / ChatGPT / Cursor / Notion AI), occasional use is not enough for this role. * Self\-directed, knows what to do next without being told and fills gaps proactively. **Bonus \& Plus:** * Overseas (US / Europe) work or living experience. * Background in Voice AI, Conversational AI, MarTech, or Sales Tech. * Hands\-on with AI prototyping tools (Claude Code, v0, Cursor), able to independently build simple prototypes. * Has previously defined evaluation criteria or success metrics for AI products. **Ideal Traits:** * Thrives in a fast\-paced, "just do things" startup environment. * Comfortable navigating ambiguity and bringing structure where processes are still evolving. * Curious and self\-driven, with a willingness to learn and adapt quickly. * Collaborative and respectful communicator, building positive relationships with engineering, leadership, and customers.

new_jobs.title: 【企業服務部】B2B業務開發 （人才發展與AI顧問解決方案）
new_jobs.jd: ▎這份工作在做什麼 1\. 負責推廣與規劃「企業領導力課程」、「數位轉型顧問」與「AI相關解決方案」，提供量身定制的企業培訓發展解決方案與AI轉型顧問服務，協助資深客戶經理整理名單、過濾有效 leads、推進執行進程。 2\. 彙整來自不同產業領域與部門的客戶需求，與顧問服務部與合作講師團隊共同設計企業解決方案。 3\. 主持客戶專案需求討論會議，從提案到採購議價全程參與，確保企業客戶的每個決策環節順利進行，提升合作效率與雙方滿意度。 4\. 主動聯繫現有與潛在客戶，持續提供公司最新的洞察與資訊，促進長期合作夥伴關係的建立，並強化企業品牌形象。 5\. 輪流主持內部業務會議，掌控每個專案的進度，確保項目團隊能夠達成目標，並就潛在風險提出可行的解決方案。 6\. 確保上級主管交辦的專案與任務順利完成，支持公司整體戰略推進，並提升企業服務價值。 ▎負責解決方案 ◎ 企業領導力與培訓相關課程 ◎ 顧問服務(Business Consultant and IT Consultant) ◎ AI與自動化數位課程（Microsoft、Open AI、Anthropic Claude、Google） ▎這份工作可以學到什麼 不同於傳統產業的業務角色，先行智庫擁有超過700家的多元客戶群，涵蓋國際龍頭外商、金融機構、科技製造業、零售服務以及傳統產業。你將深入接觸這些領域的精英，建立廣泛而強大的業界人脈網絡。你就像企業的專業顧問，針對每個客戶的獨特挑戰，設計專屬的「企業培訓」或「顧問輔導」方案，真正成為解決問題的推手。目前先行智庫也是多家國際軟體科技大廠指定的AI合作顧問公司。 在這裡，你不僅有機會與台灣上市櫃企業的董事長、總經理、人資主管及業務高層面對面交流，還能與國際軟體策略夥伴、台灣頂尖的線上訓練平台合作，讓你的業務技能與視野不斷躍升，站在數位轉型的最前沿。 這裡的業務合作絕非單打獨鬥，還有無數與執行長、各部門主管及策略夥伴的Joint Call機會。透過系統化的團隊合作，你將不僅提升個人的業務能力，更能學習如何運用全局思維解決複雜問題。 我們的願景，是成為企業「人才升級與數位轉型」的首選策略夥伴。 先行智庫為台灣第一家專注於此領域的科技管理顧問公司，聚焦於領導力發展計畫 與 AI 轉型專案的規劃與落地執行。 我們以顧問專案模式運作，從策略診斷、訓練方案設計、顧問陪跑、專案管理到成效評估，全程與企業高階團隊協作，確保轉型不僅停留在規劃階段，而是轉化為可衡量的組織能力與營運成果。 我們不只是提供建議，而是作為「Digital Transformation Service Integrator」，串接技術解決方案、學習設計與變革管理，確保轉型不只是工具導入，而是組織能力的重塑。 ▎獎金制度 ◎ 個人業績目標達成獎金：每季績效獎金另計(4、7、10、1合併當月月薪發放） ▎加分職務項目 1\. 有直接或間接人力資源背景，或者有訓練相關經驗。 2\. 曾有 B2B 業務經驗者優先考慮，想往科技管理顧問業發展，且對企業培訓與數位轉型等領域有興趣。
